mapping.scope: Source/mathematical mapping; no external code reuse, execution, learner or training approval

methods.existing_scarx_support: Research ReadoutEligibility has own-neuron forward traces and one-step learned readout error; serving G1 uses reward-modulated STDP, not e-prop.
methods.mathematical_difference: Author ALIF epsilon_v follows alpha*epsilon_v+presynaptic input with spike-gradient paths stopped; adaptive epsilon_a follows (rho-beta*psi)*epsilon_a+psi*epsilon_v with explicit temporal indexing. SCAR-X35 differentiates its own post-reset voltage including threshold/reset terms and uses sigmoid slope, not the author's triangular/refractory surrogate. Both omit other-neuron future error effects in their local approximation.
methods.cost: Streaming local eligibility O(P+H), forward/trace O(P) per tick plus O(H*O) feedback per endpoint. The author's verification tf.scan stores time-major traces O(T*B*P); that is not a necessary online serving cost.
methods.risks: Reset convention, surrogate damping, readout normalization and temporal indexing differ; matching finite differences of one anchored local graph does not certify full-network gradient or useful representation.
methods.experiment_needed: H1: reset-Jacobian credit audit/ablation with fixed forward and matched actual update norm; retain frozen/zero/shuffled/readout controls. Do not rerun STOP35-38 with only different seeds or learning rates.
methods.authorization: Read-only mapping/engineering authorized; exact proposal30 prototype already exists. New reset-rule training requires explicit approval and fresh registration.
methods.license_review: Cached LICENSE contains three-clause BSD-style terms; repository API returned NOASSERTION. Preserve notices if any future code is reused. No code was reused in this audit.

methods.existing_scarx_support: Output-local supervised delta and recurrent spiking state exist; no implemented multi-layer local-classifier DECOLLE reproduction in serving.
methods.mathematical_difference: Each local classifier forms its own error; a surrogate derivative multiplies local error and filtered presynaptic activity. Layers/state detach restrict the differentiation graph. This differs from one shared recurrent head broadcasting error to all neurons.
methods.cost: State/filter memory per layer plus weights, local classifier, optimizer and local autograd buffers. No necessary time-unrolled full-network tape, but exact implementation cost depends on detach and update schedule.
methods.risks: Local classifiers can impose the wrong representation; feedforward detach design cannot be called an already validated recurrent credit rule. License texts conflict.
methods.experiment_needed: A local auxiliary objective would change learning signals and requires a separately approved architecture/objective study after current evidence review.
methods.authorization: Concept/source audit only. Do not copy/import this framework into candidate or serving.
methods.license_review: README labels GPLv3, LICENSE.txt begins with non-commercial/commercial-reservation restrictions and later BSD text. Treat as unresolved; no code reuse authorization is inferred.

methods.existing_scarx_support: G1 reward-modulated STDP, research PlasticCore score eligibility and activity/update-importance heuristics. These are related mechanisms, not an MSTDPET reproduction.
methods.mathematical_difference: MSTDPET low-pass filters a point STDP eligibility then applies reward*eligibility_trace. Default timing uses the previous point eligibility; zero_lag folds current spikes first. G1 uses its own causal/anti-causal traces and endpoint reward advantage without this separate delayed eligibility state.
methods.cost: About two per-synapse eligibility arrays plus neuron traces; O(P) dense update per reward tick. Batch/connection implementation can multiply that cost.
methods.risks: Reward timing can reverse the credited event. Scalar reward has high variance and weak neuronal credit; traces changing does not prove representation learning.
methods.experiment_needed: A timing/lag audit is a possible control, not a rename of failed scalar-STDP/score trials. New learner training needs a causal timing hypothesis and approval.
methods.authorization: Read source and compare equations only; no Torch import or code reuse in serving.
methods.license_review: AGPL-3.0 in pinned repository; do not assume serving compatibility or permission to relicense copied code.

methods.existing_scarx_support: Bounded replay, EMA/metaplasticity and output-local SI adaptation exist. Not whole-network Fisher EWC/SI/GEM implementations.
methods.mathematical_difference: SI accumulates loss-linked path contribution divided by squared displacement; EWC penalizes movement with estimated Fisher. GEM constrains gradients against remembered tasks; A-GEM uses a reference gradient. Cached repo scripts delegate to Avalanche, so this audit does not certify Avalanche internals.
methods.cost: Readout SI adds work/importance/anchor O(P_out); online diagonal EWC about two O(P) arrays; GEM may keep O(tasks*P) gradient constraints and replay; A-GEM two gradients plus replay. Exact framework costs are not measured here.
methods.risks: A local activity surrogate is not a Fisher or loss gradient. Strong importance can preserve low accuracy and exhaust plasticity. Task boundaries and replay labels can leak privileged information.
methods.experiment_needed: Prepare boundary-free verified replay/consolidation comparisons with equal memory, examples and compute after useful P1 representation is established. P2 gate remains final/acquisition>=65%, mean forgetting<=3pp, worst<=5pp for all registered seeds.
methods.authorization: Fixtures, memory estimates and protocol only. New P2 usefulness/retention training remains unapproved; global-gradient controls must remain separate.
methods.license_review: Wrapper repository MIT; delegated Avalanche and dependencies require their own review before any reuse.

methods.existing_scarx_support: Own-neuron surrogate eligibility and supervised readout feedback have related ingredients; no exact SuperSpike/Auryn reproduction.
methods.mathematical_difference: A filtered presynaptic PSP times surrogate postsynaptic slope forms a synaptic trace; another temporal filter combines it with a filtered error. Hidden error routing and delay filters differ from SCAR-X35's endpoint readout feedback and own reset/adaptation sensitivity.
methods.cost: Per-synapse filtered traces O(P), neuron error/filter states O(H), sparse connection traversal; simulator/delay buffers and feedback need additional accounting.
methods.risks: Error source and random/symmetric feedback choices matter. The released simulator and task setup are not evidence a local SCAR-X learner will solve language or forgetting.
methods.experiment_needed: Source-informed error-timing/surrogate controls only after separate protocol; no wholesale simulator import or rebranded STOP35 trial.
methods.authorization: Read-only mathematical comparison; new mechanism/copying needs review and approval.
methods.license_review: GPL-3.0 pinned source. No source reused or executed.

methods.existing_scarx_support: NumPy/native ALIF math and local learning tests exist. No serving dependency or claimed framework-equivalent training result.
methods.mathematical_difference: A simulation/tooling framework, not one learning rule. LIF detach_reset is an explicit graph choice; STDP and online learning modules have separate semantics. Importing an online wrapper does not prove locality or remove time/space gradients.
methods.cost: Single-step state is O(H); multi-step/autograd modes can retain O(T*H) or more intermediates. Kernel/backend and optimizer costs must be measured separately from SCAR-X.
methods.risks: Confusing a simulator feature with a new credit assignment rule; hidden autograd use, detach mismatch and unnecessary dependencies.
methods.experiment_needed: Optional independent math/control backend after matching equations, reset timing and source license; no need to install it for current NumPy audit.
methods.authorization: Read-only reference. Any backward control belongs in evaluation/controls.py, never serving or candidate learner.
methods.license_review: Apache-2.0 pinned source, with attribution/NOTICE review before copying; no code copied or executed.

hypotheses.claim: The own-reset derivative terms in SCAR-X35 may attenuate or misalign delayed local eligibility relative to a stopped-reset approximation. Same forward spikes and matched applied update norm can distinguish a credit-path effect from a larger-step effect.
hypotheses.novelty: Known approximation choice, not a new e-prop invention; task utility is unproven.

hypotheses.claim: With the unchanged public lexical/hash encoder, some fact/scoping paraphrases may remain poorly separated despite no exact collisions. A source-blind fixed-feature diagnostic can separate encoding/readout limits from hidden training failure before any new codec or learner.
hypotheses.novelty: Causal diagnostic, not a new architecture. No learned embedding, fact-ID input or answer lookup.

cost_arithmetic.scope: Arithmetic estimates only; exclude weights/stable copies, allocator, snapshots, label metadata and framework runtime. Not peak RAM or an energy/speed measurement.
